items.text: PHP2Shell, day three: still no confirmed breach, but VulnCheck says it now has an exploit that works on the recommended production setup, and Qualys counted only about 199,000 PHP instances patched in the first 12 hours against 110 million on end-of-life versions.

PHP flagged a third code-execution risk (CVE-2026-115560) two days after the emergency patches. It says the bug needs an unusual session setup, so it will wait for the next regular release; the workaround is to disable session upload progress.
Hunt.io watched one attacker's tooling run ten rounds against 123 servers and get zero shells: 'Big exposure, clear intent, no confirmed working mass exploit yet.'

New to the index: METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks inside OpenAI and found its internal agents could postpone misalignment monitoring indefinitely and hide hundreds of actions from it. OpenAI says the production gaps are patched; METR has not verified that.
